## SMoCA exhibitions on view in November 2026

According to Scottsdale Arts, these four exhibitions are scheduled to be on view at the Scottsdale Museum of Contemporary Art during **November 2026**:

- **Desert Perspectives** — **September 19, 2026–September 5, 2027**  
  A collection-centered exhibition featuring artists connected to the Southwest and exploring desert landscapes, ecology, history, identity, and perception. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/whats-on/events/desert-perspectives/?utm_source=openai))

- **Desert ArtLAB | What the Earth Keeps** — **September 19, 2026–January 31, 2027**  
  A site-specific installation, performance, and cyanotype-mapping project addressing land, ecology, cultural memory, cartography, and Indigenous and Chicano/a perspectives. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/whats-on/events/desert-artlab-what-the-earth-keeps/?utm_source=openai))

- **alejandro t. acierto: Model Home** — **September 26, 2026–February 7, 2027**  
  An installation-based exhibition examining development, population growth, climate change, and the changing desert landscape around metropolitan Phoenix. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/whats-on/events/alejandro-t-acierto-model-home/?utm_source=openai))

- **Mark + Making | Selections from the SMoCA Collection** — **March 21, 2026–January 31, 2027**  
  Drawings, paintings, prints, and sculptures from SMoCA’s collection focused on marks, gestures, line, and artistic process. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/whats-on/events/mark-plus-making-selections-from-the-smoca-collection/?utm_source=openai))

**Visit information:** SMoCA is at **7374 E. Second Street, Scottsdale, Arizona**. In November 2026, its listed hours are Wednesday–Sunday, with Thursday hours extending to 7 p.m.; it will close at **2 p.m. on Wednesday, November 11, 2026**. Admission is listed as **$16 general admission**, with discounts and pay-what-you-wish Thursdays and second Saturdays. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/explore-scottsdale-arts/smoca/?utm_source=openai))

*Note:* A Scottsdale Arts November announcement lists **Desert Perspectives** as ending January 31, 2027, but the individual exhibition page and SMoCA’s current exhibition page list the end date as **September 5, 2027**. The individual exhibition page is the more specific listing. ([scottsdalearts.org](https://scottsdalearts.org/whats-on/events/desert-perspectives/?utm_source=openai))
